basic_profile.bio: Hey all! I'm Alex, a 25-year-old from Austin, Texas. I'm a huge fan of mobile gacha games, especially CounterSide, which I've been hooked on since it launched. I work part-time at a local retail store and spend my free time gaming or going to local music gigs. I'm single and enjoying the freedom to explore my hobbies. Online mostly during the evenings, as that's when I usually unwind after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from being an avid gamer and spending a lot of time on gaming forums. I have a decent understanding of mobile games, especially strategy-based ones. I also keep up with gaming news and trends through YouTube and Reddit.
